three.module.min.js and three.core.min.js are the official three.js build,
copied unmodified from release r184. Three.js is MIT, copyright the Three.js authors.
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

HDRLoader.js and RGBELoader.js are the matching loaders from the same
release's examples/jsm/loaders/, copied unmodified.

Nothing else from three.js ships with this site. The only consumer is
lab/cd.js, which dynamic-imports three.module.min.js and HDRLoader.js when
the CD experiment mounts, so the library never loads on pages that do not
need it, and the 2D canvas version of the disc stays as the fallback where
WebGL is unavailable. The studio HDRI it lights the disc with is described
in env/SOURCE.txt.

Do not edit these files. To upgrade, replace all four together from one
three.js release.
